title: TODO marker in a calculation comment
description: Unfinished-work rule — a FileMaker calculation carries a TODO marker (TODO, TO DO, TO-DO, TBD, to be done, to be defined) inside one of its comments. Five slots are scanned: custom-function bodies, field calculations, auto-enter and validation calculations, and script step calculations. The marker only counts inside a comment segment (// to end of line, or /* … */) — a string literal "TODO" in a Substitute() is not a finding. A TODO describes planned work, not a defect, so the severity is info: the rule counts with its own figure but never turns the traffic light yellow. The defect half of the family is calc_comment_fixme.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A TODO in a calculation comment records a formula that is knowingly incomplete — a rounding rule still to be agreed, a case not yet covered. That is a stock figure, not a defect.
rule.remediation: Nothing to fix per finding. Use the inventory to see where formulas are still provisional, and move anything with an owner and a date into the tracker.

meta.name: TODO marker in a calculation comment
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Unfinished-work rule — a TODO marker inside a calculation comment. Detector canon of the family: (?i)(\bto[\s\-_]?do|\btbd\b|\bto[\s\-_]be[\s\-_](done|defined)\b), verified by tools/tests/rules/unfinished_work_detector.sql, which also covers the comment-segment extraction; the family deliberately omits the trailing word boundary so plural markers ("TO DOs") still match. Code_Chunks offers no comment type (NoRef | VariableReference | FunctionRef | CustomFunctionRef | FieldRef), so the segments are extracted by regex; a // inside a string literal (a URL) is a known limit. Overlap with calc_comment_fixme is intended.
